PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?father ?fatherName WHERE {
  dbr:Robert_Rylands'_Last_Journey dbp:director ?director .
  ?director dbp:father ?father .
  OPTIONAL { ?father rdfs:label ?fatherName . FILTER (lang(?fatherName) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 100
